findings.seen: In all photos, the athlete has long, straight, black hair pulled back into a single ponytail with no fringe. In photos 2, 3, and 4 (during sports and outdoors), it is a high, tight ponytail. In photo 1 (at home), it is a lower, looser ponytail.
The athlete has a slim, athletic build. Photos 2 and 3 in particular show moderate muscle definition in her arms and legs. Her shoulders appear slightly wider than her hips.

Photo 2 shows a sleeveless deep teal jersey with a white V-neck collar. On the front left chest is a circular white patch with a teal anchor logo inside. The number 5 is printed in large white font in the center of the chest. The side seams are solid teal. The back of the jersey is not visible.

In photo 2, the athlete wears plain black, tight-fitting spandex shorts with no visible markings. In photo 3, she wears similar black shorts but with a small white manufacturer's logo on the lower left thigh.
In photo 3, a plain white ankle sock is visible on her left ankle, just above the shoe. In photo 2, a sliver of white is visible at the ankle inside the shoe.

Photo 3 shows the athlete wearing court shoes that are primarily white with blue and purple/pink sections on the sides and heel. The soles are white. A small manufacturer's logo is visible on the side.

In photos 2 and 3, the athlete wears black knee pads on both knees, each with a small white manufacturer's logo on the front. No volleyball is seen in her possession. A basket of yellow and blue volleyballs is visible in the background of photo 3.
In photo 2, a round white patch containing a teal anchor is located on the upper left side of the chest of her jersey.
